contracts.source: HPE press release: HPE secures its first AMD Helios order in $1.2 billion deal (09-30-2026)
contracts.signal: HPE's release: Vultr placed a $1.2 billion order - HPE's first order for the AMD Helios AI Rack by HPE - to deploy Helios racks (72 AMD Instinct MI455X GPUs and six HPE Juniper Networking QFX5252 scale-up switch trays per rack) at Vultr's cloud data center locations in the United States; the order builds on nearly three years of collaboration between Vultr and Juniper Networks.
contracts.units: Helios racks of 72 AMD Instinct MI455X GPUs each (rack count not stated)
